Pathworks / Field guide
Every world needs a way through.
Draw roads, trails, walkways, fences and navigation routes. Control points are the source of truth; meshes are rebuilt from those points.
V / N / B / I / ESelect / draw / brush / insert / erase
Left click / dragUse the current tool
Right drag / Shift + right dragOrbit / pan
Wheel / F / TZoom / frame selection / top view
Shift + drag a handleRaise or lower that control point
Enter / EscapeFinish drawing / cancel current stroke
Delete / Ctrl or Cmd + DRemove selected point or path / duplicate path
Ctrl or Cmd + Z / Shift + ZUndo / redo
Space / G / HPreview followers / ground grid / hide panels
Ctrl or Cmd + S / ?Save project / open this guide
Junctions: enable control-point snapping and drop one handle onto another. Linked points move together. Insert a point before creating a T-junction. Crossing ribbons alone do not join routes. Junction caps are preview geometry, not a boolean-unioned road mesh.
Height: Follow terrain stores point heights as offsets. Absolute / bridge stores world heights. Switching mode preserves control-point positions, though the curve between them can change. Hold Shift while dragging a point for elevation.
Files: Save project keeps paths, settings, terrain and camera in JSON. Mesh export creates a binary glTF (.glb) of the visible generated paths. Surface shader grain is not baked into GLB; base colors and physical material settings are included. Navigation export contains sampled waypoints and directed connections.
Offline: the built-in WebGL2 renderer needs no network. Three.js r180 is used when its pinned CDN module is available. The two renderers share geometry and editor behavior; their shading is not pixel-identical. When WebGL2 is unavailable, a low-detail CPU preview remains usable for editing. It uses flat shading without shadows. No files are uploaded.
Scope: no traffic AI, collision resolution, lane-level turns, automatic grading, automatic crossings, or arbitrary 3D tunneling. Tight curves and extreme widths can overlap. Undo is bounded to 60 edits.


Export / Local files
Bring your paths into the world.
GLB geometry is a baked snapshot, not an editable Pathworks project. Keep your project JSON for later edits. Save your browser draft explicitly before clearing local storage.
